purpose: Predeclare the evidence required to promote Frozen R2.6 from HOLD. This specification evaluates R2.6; it may not modify R2.6.

decision_states.HOLD_COLLECTING: Promotion review is not yet eligible.
decision_states.EXTEND: Calendar minimum has been reached but one or more required evidence cohorts remain immature or inconclusive without a hard failure.
decision_states.PASS: All eligibility requirements, integrity hard gates and primary performance gates pass at a separately executed promotion review.
decision_states.FAIL: An integrity hard failure occurs or a mature primary performance gate fails. FAIL does not authorize tuning Frozen R2.6.

review_eligibility.rule: If any required eligibility item is below minimum after the calendar minimum, decision is EXTEND, not FAIL.

episode_order_mdd_R.rationale: Predeclared safety tolerance at 1.5x the absolute Frozen R2.5 historical diagnostic MDD of -4.0R.

state_quality_gate.rule: Every eligible adjacent reached-state mean_terminal_R must be non-decreasing.
state_quality_gate.overall_requirement: Both ALL adjacent comparisons must be eligible and pass for PASS. Every eligible LONG or SHORT comparison must also pass. Ineligible direction-specific comparisons do not fail the model.

cycle_safety_gate.rule: Any eligible direction x regime bucket below -0.15R is FAIL. Buckets below minimum n remain N/A and do not by themselves block PASS.
cycle_safety_gate.source: Reuse R2.4/R2.5 cycle secondary audit rule

mature_bear_short_safety.rule: If eligible, MATURE_BEAR SHORT mean R must be >= -0.15R. If n<10 it remains N/A.
mature_bear_short_safety.note: R2.4 MATURE_BEAR remains Seed-only risk capped at 0.30R.

early_detection_quality.rationale: R2.3 awareness has zero capital authority and the historical R2.3 diagnostic explicitly did not predeclare a conversion promotion gate. A minimum one 4H cadence median lead is required only to demonstrate genuine advance warning.

promotion_decision_rule.PASS: Review eligibility complete AND all integrity hard gates pass AND all primary performance gates pass AND state quality gate passes AND no eligible cycle or MATURE_BEAR safety bucket fails.
promotion_decision_rule.EXTEND: No hard failure, but one or more required eligibility or state cohorts are immature/N/A after the calendar minimum.
promotion_decision_rule.FAIL: Any integrity hard gate fails, any mature primary performance gate fails, state quality fails when eligible, or any eligible cycle/MATURE_BEAR safety bucket breaches its floor.
promotion_decision_rule.HOLD_COLLECTING: Before minimum 365 strict-forward calendar days or before a formal promotion review.

governance.amendment_policy: Any future change to this promotion specification must be versioned as a new prospective spec and applies only to data collected after that new spec freeze; it cannot retroactively reinterpret prior R2.6 strict-forward evidence.
